question: Which eminent economist was honoured with the Punyabhushan Puraskar in June 2025 for contributions to economics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijay Kelkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dr. **Vijay Kelkar**, a distinguished **economist** and former **civil servant**, was honored with the prestigious **Punyabhushan Puraskar** in **June 2025** for his monumental contributions to the field of **economics** and **public policy** in **India**.
 
• The **Punyabhushan Puraskar**, which translates to **"Jewel of Pune,"** is an award established by the **Punyabhushan Foundation** (Tridal) to recognize eminent personalities who have brought glory to the city of **Pune** and the nation through their exceptional work.
 
• The selection for this honor was conducted by a high-level committee, which has historically been chaired by eminent scientists like **Dr. Raghunath Mashelkar**.
 
• Dr. **Vijay Kelkar** is widely acclaimed for his visionary leadership as the **Chairman** of the **13th Finance Commission**, where he played a crucial role in shaping the **fiscal federalism** of **India**.
